item.title: Fly tipping Rushdene SE2 9RP, 19th August
item.description:
Have never witnessed the fly tipping. It's been happening for years! Always this same corner!? Have no idea who is doing it. But it seems like it is a popular dumping ground! I've never reported it before and wasn't aware that I could. It happens on a weekly...even day to day basis. Maybe others report it and it gets cleared. But it keeps on happening! It's as if people know that they can do it because it gets cleared eventually. I'm unsure how it will get resolved? It's a merry-go-round. Dump it there and the Council will clear it up? It's not pleasant when you live in this road seeing all sorts of rubbish constantly tipped in the same place all the time. What can you do to resolve this?

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 63,65,67,69,71,73, Rushdene, West Heath, Greater London
